==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|topick|qq=obsolete}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|la|topica}}, from {{der|en|grc|τοπικός||pertaining to a place, local, pertaining to a common place, or topic, topical}}, from {{m|grc|τόπος||a place}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɒpɪk/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɑpɪk/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-topic.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɒpɪk|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|top|ic}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|?}}

# [[topical|topical]]

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[subject]]; a [[theme]]; a category or general area of interest.
#: {{syn|en|ground}}
#: {{ux|en|A society where a '''topic''' cannot be discussed, does not have free speech.}}
#: {{ux|en|stick to the '''topic'''}}
#: {{ux|en|an interesting '''topic''' of conversation}}
#: {{ux|en|romance is a '''topic''' that frequently comes up in conversation}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-08-03|volume=408|issue=8847|title=[http://www.economist.com/news/science-and-technology/21582495-computers-will-help-people-understand-brains-better-and-understanding-brains The machine of a new soul]|passage=The yawning gap in neuroscientists’ understanding of their '''topic''' is in the intermediate scale of the brain’s anatomy.}}
# {{lb|en|linguistics}} The entity or idea that a [[clause]] or [[sentence]] is about.
# {{lb|en|Internet}} A [[discussion]] [[thread]].
# {{lb|en|computing}} A [[component]] similar to a [[message queue]] which supports [[multiple]] [[subscriber]]s. 
# {{lb|en|music}} A [[musical]] [[sign]] intended to suggest a particular [[style]] or [[genre]].
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} An [[argument]] or [[reason]].
# {{lb|en|obsolete|medicine}} An external local application or remedy, such as a plaster, a blister, etc.
#* {{RQ:Burton Melancholy|edition= 2nd|passage= Amongst '''topics''' or outward medicines none are more precious than baths.}}

====Usage notes====
* In English, topics are usually identified by [[word order]], [[intonation]] and context, rather than by a dedicated grammatical marker. A topic is often clause-initial, but may occur elsewhere.

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|area of interest}} {{l|en|subject}}, {{l|en|subject area}}
